svg.title: From GPU runs to the figures
svg.desc: GPU runs (scripts/ and the experiments' run scripts) write verdicts and scores to results/. The analyses (each experiment's analyze.py, or experiments/run_all.py) turn them into CSV and JSON tables in results/analysis/. figures/make_figures.py draws the figures from those tables, into results/figures/ and, in the dark theme, assets/figures/.
